geometry_edits.rationale: Keep the main host but make the dominant operation explicitly courtyard-driven so the massing can support an active ground threshold.
Open the court to the access side so the frontage reads as public rather than sealed.
Strengthen the carved void while preserving a compact, capacity-aware bar mass.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the dominant mass to a clearer courtyard-based host that can produce a legible public void at the access edge.
Align the primary void/opening to the verified access side in the program frame.
Reduce the void margin slightly so the court becomes more legible as occupiable public ground rather than a shallow internal carve.

rationale: The candidate reads as a single compact mass with a recognizable dominant bar, so it is not fragmented, but the visible logic is still too closed for the neighborhood_living brief. The blue frontage edge is not answered by a clear public void, court, or undercut; instead the mass presents mostly sealed faces and an internal-looking subtraction. Across views the object is coherent, but the section is generic and does not strongly express active ground, public threshold, or a capacity-aware residential/commercial edge. The silhouette is acceptable as an early massing, though the top carving and wedge-like cuts feel more like an abstract book-form mutation than a programmatic neighborhood building. Reference 3 is the closest transferable lesson for active frontage, but the candidate currently under-delivers on that principle.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Tower-like vertical emphasis is far more slender and tall than the candidate's low bar mass; use only the idea of a dominant mass with controlled carve, not the typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact mixed-use mass can gain clarity through a dominant prismatic body plus selective top setbacks/cuts, preserving one primary volume while modulating the silhouette.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower section logic does not match a low neighborhood-living bar; avoid importing tall-slender tower form.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single mass with a subtle vertical deformation can read as one coherent figure if the section remains continuous.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate lacks the clear open threshold and crisp entry condition seen here; also its current carving is more internal than street-addressed.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low street-facing volume with a legible entry/canopy and a smaller vertical accent can support active ground-edge program.

warnings: Visible access edge is not convincingly transformed into a public threshold.
The void reads more like an internal cut than a usable street-facing court or seam.
Program fit fails because the neighborhood_living brief requires a legible active ground edge and public space logic.
Do not reward the mass simply for being inside the parcel; containment is only a hard gate.
